temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices that Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated hospital worker with a demanding job, but he did not yet know the full severity of Gary's overwork or its impact on his health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan learns and confirms that Gary is severely overworking and is unwilling or unable to step away because of hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overcommitted at the hospital and may be harming his health; he needs rest and support, but his workload makes him resistant to taking a break.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and worry for Gary's health.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene supportively, encourage Gary to rest, and find a way to help him relax despite his initial refusal.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussing work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary admits that his situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was overworked by hospital obligations and needed rest, but he had not yet known whether there were deeper personal reasons behind Gary's behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Gary's restlessness, avoidance, and admission make Ethan suspect that Gary's overwork is not only professional and that Gary is hiding complicated personal burdens.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is carrying burdens beyond work and may be struggling personally; he needs nonjudgmental support to open up.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and growing suspicion or alarm.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently, reassure him that he can trust Ethan, and encourage him to share what is really going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He also agrees that Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities could help him organize his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected there was more to Gary's overwork than professional obligations and believed Gary was hiding complicated burdens.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan now understands the specific reasons behind Gary's behavior: pressure from managing a new department plus personal challenges. He also learns that Gary is receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is driven by both professional and personal pressures, and with help organizing tasks and delegating, he can work toward a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary and sees that Gary is making efforts to change. Gary reports that he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary could improve with support, but Gary still faced challenges and needed ongoing encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan sees evidence that Gary is following through on changes and benefiting from them; Gary's progress is real, though challenges remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier work-life balance and can continue improving with support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in with Gary, offering support and encouragement as he manages remaining challenges.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and thanks Ethan for his support. Ethan sees that Gary is capable of managing on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was progressing well but might still need regular support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Ethan now believes Gary has reached a stable, independent healthier balance and no longer requires active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of managing independently and has achieved a healthier work-life balance; Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfaction and happiness for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support and check-ins, while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
